verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo describes E2B as open-source infrastructure and points to a self-hosting guide that deploys the infrastructure with Terraform. The SDK docs also explicitly support configuring clients for self-hosted or BYOC deployments, so self-hosting the core product is a documented first-party capability. Missing for 10: details of the self-hosting guide (supported clouds, requirements, feature parity with the hosted service), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.
